mapper.insert: INSERT INTO push_subscriptions (member_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth_secret, language_code) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{endpoint}, #{p256dh}, #{authSecret}, #{languageCode}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_id = VALUES(member_id), p256dh = VALUES(p256dh), auth_secret = VALUES(auth_secret), language_code = VALUES(language_code)
mapper.select: SELECT push_subscription_id, member_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth_secret, language_code FROM push_subscriptions WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY push_subscription_id
